name: daisyui
tagline_zh: 写 HTML/JSX 时不用开口，它自动用上 daisyUI 的按钮、卡片、表单。省去翻文档挑类名。
tagline_en: Write HTML/JSX and get daisyUI's buttons, cards, forms auto-applied. No doc-hunting for class names—your code.
desc_en: Official daisyUI component-library skill for Tailwind CSS. When you write HTML or JSX code, you must use it. Even if the user does not request it, use it.
why_zh: 它把组件库的约定直接焊进你的编码流程：不问你、不打断，输出即成品。适合批量产出风格统一的界面片段。
why_en: It welds the component library's conventions straight into your coding flow—no prompts, no interruptions, output is.
limit_zh: 只认 Tailwind CSS 项目，且需已安装 daisyUI。不负责视觉设计决策，也不生成完整页面布局。
limit_en: Requires a Tailwind CSS project with daisyUI installed. No design decisions or full-page layouts; beyond component snippets, it may force-fit.
title_en: Auto-apply daisyUI components to your Tailwind code
